title: Bicentennial orchestrations and gospel choir pieces
summary: Wilson clarifies the Music Center and Hollywood Bowl 1976 performances and his gospel-choir orchestrations for the Philharmonic.

blocks.x: Well let’s go back to the concert at the – probably at the Hollywood Bowl?
The first one was at the music center. Then the one at the Hollywood bowl was the ’76…
Yeah, that – what was that celebration, three hundred years, or what?
Bicentennial, that was two hundred years.

Bicentennial, yeah that number they played that number that I did for the um, for the philharmonic, and then they used to have this big – they used to have this big gospel contest every year. Gospel people come from everywhere. You know, so I had written these numbers – these gospel numbers with the choir, orchestrated them for the philharmonic. So the philharmonic, they won. They won – my number won at the forum. At the forum, they’d have it at the forum every year. Yeah,
